# Revoray

> Official site for Revoray performance sports eyewear featuring XPatina-Tech photochromic lens technology, cycling sunglasses, ski goggles, and UV protection for athletes.

Revoray specializes in affordable high-performance eyewear with proprietary technologies like XPatina-Tech Pro lenses, REVO Vacuum Coating, and Color Enhancing optics. The brand partners with athletes like MTB Trials World Champion David Cachon and offers product lines including Fire N1, Passion M series, Brisk Y2, and Eos models.

## Key Topics

- XPatina-Tech Pro lens technology
- Photochromic Lenses
- Polarized Lenses
- UV420 Eye Protection
- Color Enhancing Lenses
- High Contrast Lenses
- Fire N1 series
- Passion M series (M1, M2, M3, M Pro)
- REVO Vacuum Coating
- Italy Anti-Fog Lens
- Sports cycling sunglasses
- Ski goggles
- David Cachon partnership
- 17TRACK order tracking
